query: select s.telegram_id as snap_id, s.username as snap_user, s.badge_tier, p.telegram_id as player_id, p.username as player_user, p.inventory->>'badge_silver' as badge_silver, p.inventory->>'badge_gold' as badge_gold, left(p.inventory::text,200) as inv_head from weekly_leaderboard_snapshots s left join players p on p.telegram_id::text = s.telegram_id::text where s.week_id='2026-W34' and s.rank=3
